meta.title: International Household Moving from Panama | Global Moving Solutions
meta.description: We move your household goods from Panama to all 5 continents: export packing, ocean or air freight and door-to-door customs clearance. 20 years in business. Free quote, no strings attached.

topbar.horario: Hours: Mon to Fri, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

hero.lead: Over 20 years planning, packing and shipping your belongings safely and professionally, anywhere in the world.

nosotros.p1: We have been moving households for over two decades. We handle your belongings as if they were our own, from the first box to the last.
nosotros.p2: Our network of international partners and agents lets us clear customs and deliver to any destination across the five continents.
puntos: One coordinator who knows your move by name.

servicios.lead: We handle the whole process, from the inventory in your home to the delivery at destination, so your move is a stress-free experience.

items.d: We move your household goods from Panama to any destination in the world, door to door. We handle the inventory, export packing, ocean or air freight, customs clearance at both origin and destination, and delivery inside your new home. A single coordinator is accountable for the entire move, from start to finish.

Moves within Panama City and to the interior of the country, with the same packing and the same care we apply to an international move. Ideal for changing homes, moving between apartments and relocating staff within Panama, with our own crew and a truck sized to the real volume of your home.

Corporate moves to international standard, planned so your company keeps operating. We work after hours and on weekends, label by workstation and reinstall furniture, files and IT equipment at the new site, so on Monday every person finds their desk up and running.

Full logistics to move your pet along with the family. We arrange the veterinary health certificate, the export permit, the IATA-compliant travel crate and the booking with airlines that accept live animals, plus the entry paperwork in the destination country.

Enclosed warehouses in Panama City with 24/7 surveillance, smoke detection and access control, to store your goods for days or for months. Useful while you close on a house, wait for a visa or settle a sailing date. You pay for the volume you actually occupy, not for a fixed unit.

Consolidated freight service between Panama and Miami: your goods travel in a shared container with other shipments, so you only pay for the cubic metres you use. It is the most affordable option when you do not fill a full container and are not in a hurry over the arrival date.

We file your household goods with Panama's National Customs Authority and coordinate clearance at destination through our agent network. We prepare the valued inventory, the declaration and the exemption paperwork where it applies, and tell you the applicable duties in advance so there are no surprises at the port.

We pack item by item with export-grade materials: double-wall cartons, acid-free paper for china and artwork, moving blankets for furniture and ISPM 15 stamped wooden crates for fragile pieces. At destination we unpack, reassemble the furniture and take away all the packing material.

Domestic and international transit policies covering your goods during handling, the ocean or air leg and the time in storage. We explain what each option covers and what value to declare based on the inventory, so the coverage matches what you are actually shipping.

proceso.lead: From Panama to anywhere, with the same team alongside you from start to finish.

pasos.d: We inspect your belongings at home and hand over the paperwork.
Safe arrival at your new home or office.

contacto.lead: We are ready to make your next move a success. Ask for a quote with no obligation.
contacto.f_nota: WhatsApp opens with your request already written. It reaches us instantly and you keep a copy on your phone.

footer.sobre: Your partner for international moves from Panama to anywhere in the world. Safe, on time, professional.
